QuestInfo.name: First Friend in Perion
QuestInfo.0: Dances with Balrog told you that he would introduce you to a friend to help you settle into life in Perion.
QuestInfo.1: Dances with Balrog wants you to meet Ayan, to lear more about living in Perion. Visit Ayan in Perion.
QuestInfo.2: Ayan explained that she is not from Perion, but rather was saved by the people of Perion. She lost her memory when she was little, so she doesn't actually know where she's from. According to her, everyone in Perion is quite nice, once you get to know them. Everyone, except maybe Blackbull.

0.msg: Young explorer! You must grow strong and bond with your allies before you take to the fields of battle. Seek Ayan in Perion. She will guide you.

1.msg: You will find Ayan just outside the Warriors' Sanctuary in Perion. Follow the arrows.

2.msg: Excellent. Ayan will help you find your place in Perion.\r\n#e#r(If you accept, you'll travel to Perion automatically.)#k#n

0.msg: Growing strong is good, but it cannot be done alone. Well, it can, but it's less fun and takes longer. Look, just trust me on this.

1.0: Wait! Talk to me again in a moment.

0.msg: You haven't met Ayan yet. Just leave here and follow the signs. Seriously, we put up the signs just for situations like this.
